name: io.github.Kopachelli/x402-fleet
title: Kopachelli x402 API Fleet
description: Paid data APIs (weather, finance, geo, AI) via USDC x402 micropayments.

environmentVariables.description: x402 private key (0x...) used to pay for API calls in USDC. If unset, the server runs in discovery mode and only lists endpoints/prices.
environmentVariables.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: CAIP-2 network to pay on. One of eip155:8453 (Base), eip155:137 (Polygon), eip155:42161 (Arbitrum), eip155:480 (World Chain).
environmentVariables.name: X402_NETWORK
